lng_intro_about2:
Welcome to the Yurigram Desktop app.
It's fast and secure.
lng_settings_restart_hint: WARNING: Changing options that are colored in red will take effect only after the app restarts.
lng_settings_skip_message_desc: Note: Allow ALT+↑/↓ shortcut to skip to next unread chat

lng_show_emoji_button_as_text_desc: Note: If you can't see an emoji button, please turn on this option.
lng_radio_controller_desc: Note: Radio controller is an experimental bot for controlling your music streaming session.
lng_auto_unmute_desc: Note: Auto unmute when you've joined the voice chat.
lng_settings_hide_messages_desc: Note: IT IS NOT REALLY HIDE! Messages are still available to view, but text will be converted to Spoiler and media won't auto download.
lng_net_boost_restart_desc:
You'll need to restart app to change network boost.

Restart now?

404 User not found.
Note: You must have "seen" that user before open this link.
